newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-PETER KIRSTEN RETURNS TO WP AS COACH.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PETER KIRSTEN RETURNS TO WP AS COACH.

text.p: Former record-breaking Western Province batsman Peter Kirsten is renewing his acquaintance with the province as cricket manager of the Superjuice Academy.
Kirsten, who holds several batting records for the province, replaces Eddie Barlow who resigned as head of the cricket academy due to farming commitments.
The academy is run jointly by Boland and Western Province to develop cricketers of matric age in the region. Paul Adams and Roger Telemachus are two players who have benefited from its programme.
Kirsten, 41, will take up his position on May 1.
